symbolList.symbol: This symbol indicates that this operation or action involves high voltage.
This symbol indicates that this operation or action involves Highly Flammable material.
This symbol indicates that system operation need to be stopped quickly.
This symbol indicates that this operation or action involves hot surface areas.
This symbol indicates that this operation or action to be carried out using antistatic wears.
This symbol indicates that this operation or action involves high level sound noise.

warning.para: Denotes possibility of danger to personnel due to improper use of equipment.

caution.para: Denotes possibility of damage to equipment.
